", "8": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"};
    let currentSlideIdx = 0;

    function navigateSlide(dir) {
      currentSlideIdx = (currentSlideIdx + dir + courseSlides.length) % courseSlides.length;
      updateSlideDisplay();
    }

    function jumpToSlide(idx) {
      currentSlideIdx = idx;
      updateSlideDisplay();
    }

    function updateSlideDisplay() {
      const slide = courseSlides[currentSlideIdx];
      const img = document.getElementById('carousel-slide-img');
      const badge = document.getElementById('carousel-slide-badge');
      const title = document.getElementById('carousel-slide-title');
      
      if (img && slide) {
        img.style.opacity = '0.3';
        setTimeout(() => {
          img.src = slide.src;
          img.alt = slide.title;
          img.style.opacity = '1';
        }, 150);
      }
      if (badge) badge.innerText = 'Slide ' + (currentSlideIdx + 1) + ' of ' + courseSlides.length;
      if (title && slide) title.innerText = slide.title;

      for (let i = 0; i < courseSlides.length; i++) {
        const thumb = document.getElementById('thumb-' + i);
        if (thumb) {
          if (i === currentSlideIdx) {
            thumb.className = 'shrink-0 w-24 aspect-video rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#3e6892] ring-2 ring-[#3e6892]/30 opacity-100 transition';
            thumb.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center'});
          } else {
            thumb.className = 'shrink-0 w-24 aspect-video rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-stone-300 dark:border-stone-700 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 transition';
          }
        }
      }
    }

    function toggleInfographicView(modNum, btn) {
      const vimeoEl = document.getElementById('mod-vimeo-player-' + modNum);
      const localEl = document.getElementById('mod-video-player-' + modNum);
      const infoEl = document.getElementById('mod-infographic-view-' + modNum);
      
      const isShowing = infoEl && !infoEl.classList.contains('hidden');
      if (isShowing) {
        if (infoEl) infoEl.classList.add('hidden');
        if (vimeoEl) vimeoEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (btn) btn.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 bg-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-700 rounded-lg text-stone-300 font-medium transition flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] border border-stone-700';
      } else {
        if (vimeoEl) vimeoEl.classList.add('hidden');
        if (localEl) { localEl.classList.add('hidden'); localEl.pause(); }
        if (infoEl) infoEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (btn) btn.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 bg-[#3e6892] rounded-lg text-white font-medium transition flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] border border-transparent';
      }
    }

    function seekVideo(playerId, seconds) {
      const v = document.getElementById(playerId);
      if (v) {
        v.currentTime = seconds;
        v.play();
      }
    }

    function toggleVideoTranscript(id) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) {
        el.classList.toggle('hidden');
      }
    }

    function loadCustomVideo(event, playerId) {
      const file = event.target.files[0];
      if (file) {
        const v = document.getElementById(playerId);
        if (v) {
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
          v.src = url;
          v.play();
        }
      }
    }

    function switchMediaMode(modNum, vimeoId, localFile, btn) {
      const vimeoFrame = document.getElementById('mod-vimeo-player-' + modNum);
      const localVid = document.getElementById('mod-video-player-' + modNum);
      const infoEl = document.getElementById('mod-infographic-view-' + modNum);
      if (infoEl) infoEl.classList.add('hidden');
      if (vimeoFrame && vimeoId) {
        vimeoFrame.classList.remove('hidden');
        vimeoFrame.src = 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' + vimeoId + '?badge=0&autopause=0&player_id=0&app_id=58479';
      }
      if (localVid && localFile) {
        localVid.src = localFile;
      }
      if (btn && btn.parentElement) {
        const btns = btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll('button');
        btns.forEach(b => {
          b.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-semibold text-stone-300 hover:text-white transition';
        });
        btn.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-semibold bg-[#3e6892] text-white transition';
      }
    }

    function togglePlayerSource(target, mode, btn) {
      const isTrailer = target === 'trailer';
      const vimeoEl = document.getElementById(isTrailer ? 'trailer-vimeo-player' : 'mod-vimeo-player-' + target);
      const localEl = document.getElementById(isTrailer ? 'trailer-video-player' : 'mod-video-player-' + target);
      const localBtn = document.getElementById(isTrailer ? 'trailer-local-btn' : 'mod-' + target + '-local-btn');
      
      if (mode === 'vimeo') {
        if (vimeoEl) vimeoEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (localEl) { localEl.classList.add('hidden'); localEl.pause(); }
        if (localBtn) localBtn.classList.add('hidden');
      } else {
        if (vimeoEl) vimeoEl.classList.add('hidden');
        if (localEl) localEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (localBtn) localBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
      }
      
      if (btn && btn.parentElement) {
        const btns = btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll('button');
        btns.forEach(b => {
          b.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-semibold text-stone-300 hover:text-white transition flex items-center gap-1';
        });
        btn.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-semibold bg-[#3e6892] text-white transition flex items-center gap-1';
      }
    }


    function toggleCustomAudio() {
      const audio = document.getElementById('master-audio-player');
      const icon = document.getElementById('podcast-play-icon');
      const waveBars = document.querySelectorAll('.wave-bar');
      
      if (!audio) return;
      if (audio.paused) {
        audio.play();
        if (icon) icon.setAttribute('data-lucide', 'pause');
        waveBars.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('wave-paused'));
      } else {
        audio.pause();
        if (icon) icon.setAttribute('data-lucide', 'play');
        waveBars.forEach(b => b.classList.add('wave-paused'));
      }
      if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
    }

    function updateAudioProgress() {
      const audio = document.getElementById('master-audio-player');
      const bar = document.getElementById('podcast-progress-bar');
      const curr = document.getElementById('podcast-current-time');
      const dur = document.getElementById('podcast-duration');
      
      if (!audio) return;
      if (audio.duration) {
        const pct = (audio.currentTime / audio.duration) * 100;
        if (bar) bar.style.width = pct + '%';
        if (dur) dur.innerText = formatAudioTime(audio.duration);
      }
      if (curr) curr.innerText = formatAudioTime(audio.currentTime);
    }

    function formatAudioTime(secs) {
      if (isNaN(secs)) return '0:00';
      const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
      const s = Math.floor(secs % 60);
      return m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
    }

    function seekAudioTrack(event) {
      const audio = document.getElementById('master-audio-player');
      const track = event.currentTarget;
      if (!audio || !track || !audio.duration) return;
      const rect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
      const clickX = event.clientX - rect.left;
      const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, clickX / rect.width));
      audio.currentTime = pct * audio.duration;
      updateAudioProgress();
    }

    function setAudioSpeed(speed, btn) {
      const audio = document.getElementById('master-audio-player');
      if (audio) audio.playbackRate = speed;
      if (btn && btn.parentElement) {
        btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => {
          b.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-stone-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-[11px]';
        });
        btn.className = 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#3E6892] text-white font-bold text-[11px]';
      }
    }

    function onAudioEnded() {
      const icon = document.getElementById('podcast-play-icon');
      if (icon) icon.setAttribute('data-lucide', 'play');
      document.querySelectorAll('.wave-bar').forEach(b => b.classList.add('wave-paused'));
      if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
    }

</script>
</body>
</html>
